dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Can I get an iced latte, please?
dialogue.reading: kən aɪ ˈɡɛt ən ˈaɪst ˈlɑːteɪ, ˈpliːz?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Sure. What size? Regular or large?
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. ˈwʌt ˈsaɪz? ˈrɛɡjələr ɔːr ˈlɑːrdʒ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK. A regular hot cocoa, please.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ə ˈrɛɡjələr ˈhɑːt ˈkoʊkoʊ, ˈpliːz.
